title: TCL BeyondTV, Poland unit (ro.product.model BeyondTV, board RTD2851 / rtd285o, build PPR1.180610.011 AP03,
header:
TCL BeyondTV, Poland unit (ro.product.model BeyondTV, board RTD2851 / rtd285o, build PPR1.180610.011 AP03,
security patch 2020-02-05), Android TV 9 (API 28), 2 GB RAM, Polish UI. Same platform as
examples/tcl-beyondtv-rt2851/ (build AP06), which was used as the starting point.
Tested 2026-10-21: applied in groups with a screenshot after each, then one reboot; Home, the Inputs menu,
the remote's Source/Settings buttons and Netflix checked. Not yet lived with for days.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-beyondtv-pl/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-beyondtv-pl/debloat.txt
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Live TV app: com.tcl.tv. Tuner: com.tcl.tvinput. HDMI: com.tcl.tvpassthrough.

DO NOT DISABLE (load-bearing on this firmware): com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tvpassthrough
com.tcl.sourcemananger com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice com.tcl.framework.custom com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service
com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.settings com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view
com.tcl.showmode com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService com.tcl.appstatecontroller com.realtek.netflix.setting
com.android.WifiCountryService com.tcl.versionUpdateApp (firmware updater, kept by choice) com.tcl.rc.ota

Re-enabled by the firmware at every boot (checked after a reboot): com.tcl.notereminder. Left alone.

Already disabled at the factory, left alone: the uk.co.freeview.* apps, com.tcl.bootadservice,
com.tcl.common.terminalmanagerplus, com.tcl.gallery, com.tcl.smartalexa, Stan, ZEE5, LINE TV, Rakuten TV,
Play Music/Games/Movies, Eros Now, com.google.android.tv.remote.service.

apps.note: USB media centre; nothing on USB here

optional.note: note/reminder app: firmware re-enables it at every boot, so not listed

apps.note: Google voice search and the mic button

sections.note: Off by choice: voice and screen mirroring (Chromecast and the firmware updater are kept)
Streaming apps not used (re-enable any of them with tools/restore.sh or `pm enable <package>`)
After the launcher is installed (both carry a PackageInstallerService; the Play Store stays)
